description: Call this ONLY when search_tools found no tool that fits what the user asked; never when a tool fits. It passes the request to the Whizbrew team, who read every one to see what they can add. Free; no promise and no answer comes back, so tell the user it was passed on and go on by other means. Never put a key or password in it.
